target.title: fix(media): trust known CLI transcript files
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Known speech-to-text CLIs can write the real transcript to a deterministic file while printing progress or completion text to stdout. OpenClaw previously fell through to stdout when that expected file was empty, missing, or unreadable, which could turn text such as `Transcribing with Whisper...` into user speech.

Fixes #87384 for the supported deterministic file contracts in `whisper-cli`, OpenAI Whisper, and `parakeet-mlx`.

## Why This Change Was Made

This rewrites the contributor patch around documented upstream contracts instead of recognizing a particular Node script pathname:

- whisper.cpp: `-otxt` / `--output-txt` plus `-of` / `--output-file`; the CLI appends `.txt` to the output base.
- OpenAI Whisper: an explicit `--output_dir` / `-o`, with `txt`, `all`, or the upstream default `all` selected through `--output_format` / `-f`.
- Parakeet MLX: an explicit `--output-dir`, `txt` or `all`, and the default `{filename}` template. The upstream `PARAKEET_OUTPUT_FORMAT` and `PARAKEET_OUTPUT_TEMPLATE` environment variables are honored when their flags are absent; Parakeet's actual default format remains `srt`.

Once one of those file contracts is inferred, the file is authoritative. A non-empty file returns its trimmed text. An empty or missing file returns no transcript. Unexpected read errors still fail visibly instead of being swallowed. Unknown commands, generic Node wrappers, non-text Parakeet formats, and custom Parakeet output templates retain the existing stdout contract because their output filename cannot be inferred safely.

Primary contract references:

- https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/blob/master/examples/cli/README.md
- https://github.com/openai/whisper/blob/main/whisper/transcribe.py
- https://github.com/senstella/parakeet-mlx/blob/master/parakeet_mlx/cli.py

## User Impact

Silence, failed recognition, or a missing file from a supported file-producing STT command no longer injects progress/status output into Discord voice, Google voice/Meet, Telegram voice, or other audio-message paths. Existing stdout-backed custom commands continue to behave as before.

The exact generic `node ./skills/local-whisper/transcribe.js ... --output-dir ...` shape remains stdout-backed: `{{OutputDir}}` does not define a filename, extension, or output format. A pathname-specific heuristic was intentionally removed. A generic wrapper file mode would need an explicit typed output-file contract rather than a script-name special case.

## Evidence

Published commit: `432f2c26d5eb710ac7016b922641356ec1d39527`, rebased on `8a8038170b8f18b115a3ad7988e881d5adedfc95`.

Blacksmith Testbox lease: `tbx_01kx3gbrw2b14yc2vvza9ax4ma`

Hydration run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29020770506

Focused regression suite:

```sh
corepack pnpm test src/media-understanding/runner.cli-audio.test.ts src/media-understanding/apply.test.ts
```

Result: 2 files passed, 80 tests passed. Coverage includes short/long/equal-sign flags, OpenAI Whisper's default `all`, Parakeet `txt`/`all`, Parakeet environment selection, empty and missing files for every supported contract, unexpected read errors, and preserved stdout behavior for generic Node/custom-template paths.

Changed-surface gate:

```sh
env OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 corepack pnpm check:changed
```

Result: green for core and core-test tsgo, changed-file oxlint, docs/changelog validation, conflict markers, dependency guards, database-first guard, runtime sidecar/import-cycle guards, webhook guards, and pairing guards.

Controlled executable proof used the production `runCliEntry` path with an actual executable named `whisper-cli`. The executable wrote an empty inferred `.txt`, printed `Transcribing with Whisper...` to stdout, and exited 0. Final output:

```text
LIVE_PROOF_PASS result=null progress-stdout-suppressed
```

Fresh autoreview after the final fix reported no accepted/actionable findings and rated the patch correct (`0.99`). Its remaining observation was the intentionally unsupported generic Node-wrapper filename inference described above.

Not tested: real Whisper model quality or a real Parakeet MLX model run. The changed runtime contract was proven with official upstream source, focused regressions, and an actual subprocess through the production runner.
